title: The Radiators of Milton Flats
author: Paloma Yarrow
blurb: Paloma Iversen, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
